nodes.summary: Let $w_9$ be the table of pairs $(d, \mu(d))$ for the divisors $d$ of $210$, and let $f(x) = x \log x - x$. For every natural number $n \ge 1$, writing $N = 210n$ (so that $N/d$ is an integer for each $d$ in $w_9$), we have $\sum_{(d, \mu(d)) \in w_9} \mu(d) \bigl(f(10N/d) - f(9N/d) - f(N/d)\bigr) = 48 n (10 \log 10 - 9 \log 9)$.
